entry.title: Find the right request
entry.use_when: Find the right form. Skip the portal scavenger hunt.
entry.freshness: Review after use; verify current external facts before relying on them.
entry.limitations: A reusable prompt for an existing assistant; tool access and authority come from the actual task.

pattern.activation: work depends on finding the right service request, owning team or information to include.

use_cases.title: Find the request that fits the need
